- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Physical Puzzles involve manipulating physical objects, like moving blocks or activating levers in a specific sequence to open a gate.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visual Puzzles require observation skills, such as spotting a hidden object or identifying a specific pattern in a mural or painting.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Combination Puzzles combine different types of puzzles into a single challenge, like solving a series of logic and physical puzzles to unlock a door.
